reviews.x: Bought this to make soap. Had to remove the little twigs with a tweezer. Took me about 4 hours, maybe it's the aromatherapy that calmed me down, allowing me to complete the tedious job. Not sure whether I want to do it again! Found a tiny yellow flower and a teeny snail as well.

reviews.t: I'm so sad! Wanted this for soap but I can't use ...

The shipping on the item was very fast, and I've used these dried lavender flowers for everything from sachets to lavender lemonade to lavender lime cupcakes. Cannot recommend enough! Everyone raved about the treats I made with these.

Smells wonderful! Package came very quickly and was filled so full I wondered how they got it closed...lol...it is very good quality lavender I didn't have any stalks or anything in mine, mixes beautifully into things as well.
Beautiful & worked well with my soap! Will be purchasing from this company again!!

reviews.t: Very nice and high quality blooms
reviews.x: Very nice and high quality blooms.  Excellent for my artistic needs.  I sell a lot of lavender sachet brooches on the internet and this is my choice for the lovely lavender filler!

The dried flowers were intact and very fragrant, which made them perfect for the project I was using them for: homemade bath bombs. Quick delivery as well. I will definitely order from Bulk Herbs again.
Disappointed with this Lavender! Looks more like dirt and barely smells like lavender. Thought I would save myself a trip to Chinatown in Los Angeles where I usually purchase my lavender.

reviews.t: Wonderful for making tea face toner and will be making ...
reviews.x: Very fragrant. Wonderful for making tea face toner and will be making soap with it this week.

I am tired of chemical sprays that are supposed to bring a fresh scent into my place. So it's time to get back to nature and try something basic I grew up with herbs and wildflowers and almost forgot how wonderful they are and the benefits they carry. This lavender flower is really more than I expected. I use it mainly for the aroma in my apartment. Just put a handful of the buds into a pot of boiling water and after a few minuted, the scent spreads throughout my whole place. It is clean, fresh

I don't typically write reviews, but with this product I felt like I should! I received way more than I expected honestly! So, amazing price for the quantity! It also was delivered in just one day from ordering! It actually came before another package I ordered online days before. I plan to make tea and lavender syrup for coffee with it! I'm excited!

reviews.t: This was a good seller who delivered as promised and described
reviews.x: This was a good seller who delivered as promised and described.  The lavender is lovely but  not a very strong scent for me because my 'smeller' is not the best.  I do think it has a lovely subtle fragrance.  I used it as a potpourri in Christmas ornaments for the tree.  I use clear balls that are fillable and have three holes at the top so you can smell the potpourri inside.  There are multiple ways to use the lavender buds.

I really just want to say, I love these Lavender petals. The smell is amazing as soon as you open the bag and lasts. I use in most of my products for decoration and to infuse oils. Despite the other negative feed back,  I would suggest to anyone to buy these. Just the right size for first time buyer.

This smelled divine... I ordered it to add to my flower petals that my flower girls dropped when I walked down the isle. The wedding was out doors, so we wanted to use organic materials... and the lavender smelled heavenly.

reviews.t: Love this, it smells incredible I am using it ...

Large amont in bag, nice fragrance. Used to make bath tea bags. No artificial scents that i could personally detect. Seems like a sturdy product for those of us looking to stay away from chemicals/frangrances.

reviews.t: Item arrived on time and in excellent condition.
reviews.x: The scent is so relaxing I place in my dresser drawers, under my pillows to enable me to relax and get to sleep and many other uses. Item arrived on time and in excellent condition.

reviews.t: Don't waste your time or money

I love the aroma and the usefulness as far as health. It helps to have clear thinking.

I cook with lavendar a lot so I decided to buy this. I've actually had it for about 2 years now & still have a decent amount that still are potent! A little lavendar goes a long way so if you get this definitely plan a lot of lavendar recipes/crafts!

The quantity and quality of this lavender was perfect for the rice bags that I make to ease peoples aches and pains. When heated in the microwave the fragrance of this lavender is very soothing.
The lavender flowers arrived in a plastic bag and did not include any stems, leaves, or other items. 100% Lavender. They arrived promptly, which was fortunate since I needed them for a project.

claims.text: Many reviewers praise the fragrance as wonderful, strong, and long-lasting.
Several customers report fast or quick delivery.
A number of reviewers find it great value, with generous quantity for the price.
Some customers complain about little twigs and sticks mixed in, making it unsuitable for soap-making.
A few reviewers were disappointed with the appearance or weak scent.
